Name: Explodimals 3D
Overview:
EXPLODIMALS is a fast-paced physics-puzzle-platformer. Play as a bouncy, rolling animal head that shoots bombs from its mouth and loves cake!

Roll a giant chicken down a hill, blast pandas out of a circus cannon, bounce along a carpet of monkeys: it may not make sense, but it has 100 levels, destructible environments, customizable characters, unlockable hats, and a 3DTV mode!
